/*
# SimpleLayout — stack children along an axis

The stacking idiom: siblings placed one after another along
`axis`, in child order, `spacing` apart (negative overlaps). The cross axis
and all sizes stay the children's own — a child centers itself across a row
with the ordinary `y = center`. Invisible children are skipped and their
space reclaimed; a skipped child still gets the slot it would occupy, so
re-showing it needs no special case. A `Spacer` child flexes to absorb the
run's slack along the axis (between two groups it pushes them apart; one on
each side centers the run).

Written in Declare over the Layout kernel: the whole strategy is this one
pure place() — one box per laid child, aligned by index.
*/

class SimpleLayout extends Layout [
    axis: Axis = y,
    spacing: number = 0,

    place() {
        const axis = this.axis
        const size = axis == "x" ? "width" : "height"
        const kids = this.laid()
        const flexing = (c) => (c).flexes === true

        // slack, only when someone flexes: the view's extent along the axis
        // minus the rigid content and the gaps between visible children
        let each = 0
        let flexN = 0
        for (const c of kids) if (c.visible && flexing(c)) flexN = flexN + 1
        if (flexN > 0) {
            let content = 0
            let visN = 0
            for (const c of kids) {
                if (!c.visible) continue
                visN = visN + 1
                if (!flexing(c)) content = content + (c)[size]
            }
            const extent = this.view == null ? 0 : (this.view)[size]
            each = Math.max(0, (extent - content - this.spacing * Math.max(0, visN - 1)) / flexN)
        }

        let pos = 0
        return kids.map((c) => {
            const flex = c.visible && flexing(c)
            const box = (axis == "x" ? ({ x: pos }) : ({ y: pos }))
            if (flex) box[axis == "x" ? "w" : "h"] = each
            if (c.visible) pos = pos + (flex ? each : (c)[size]) + this.spacing
            return box
            })
        },
    ]

App [ textColor = whitesmoke, fill = 0x151A22,
    warm: Color = 0xFF9F4A,
    cool: Color = 0x59C2FF,
    trackBg: Color = 0x232B36,
    hintText: Color = 0x8A97A6,

    level: number = 3,
    t: number = 3,
    ease: Spring [ attribute = t, to = { this.root.level }, stiffness = 170, damping = 20 ],
    onMouseDown() { this.level = this.level >= 5 ? 1 : this.level + 1 },

    group: View [ x = center, y = center, width = 80%, height = { this.contentHeight },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 20 ],

        readout: Text [ width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, fontSize = 30, fontWeight = bold,
            textColor = { this.root.t > 3.5 ? this.root.warm : this.root.cool },
            text = { "level " + this.root.level } ],

        track: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 10, cornerRadius = 5, fill = { this.root.trackBg },
            bar: View [ height = 10, cornerRadius = 5,
                width = { parent.width * (this.root.t / 5) },
                fill = { this.root.t > 3.5 ? this.root.warm : this.root.cool } ],
            ],

        hint: Text [ width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, fontSize = 12, textColor = { this.root.hintText },
            text = "click to raise it — the width and the color both follow" ],
        ],
    ]

App [ textColor = whitesmoke, fill = 0x151A22,
    warm: Color = 0xFF9F4A,
    cool: Color = 0x59C2FF,
    trackBg: Color = 0x232B36,
    hintText: Color = 0x8A97A6,

    level: number = 3,
    t: number = 3,
    ease: Spring [ attribute = t, to = { level }, stiffness = 170, damping = 20 ],
    onMouseDown() { level = level >= 5 ? 1 : level + 1 },

    group: View [ x = center, y = center, width = 80%, height = { this.contentHeight },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 20 ],

        readout: Text [ width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, fontSize = 30, fontWeight = bold,
            textColor = { t > 3.5 ? warm : cool },
            text = { "level " + level } ],

        track: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 10, cornerRadius = 5, fill = { trackBg },
            bar: View [ height = 10, cornerRadius = 5,
                width = { parent.width * (t / 5) },
                fill = { t > 3.5 ? warm : cool } ],
            ],

        hint: Text [ width = { parent.width }, textAlign = center, fontSize = 12, textColor = { hintText },
            text = "click to raise it — the width and the color both follow" ],
        ],
    ]
